caption: Figure 3. CXL bridges operating principle. Local flows ( 2○, 10 ○) are propagated across coherence domains with nested global transactions ( 3○, 9○). Global flows ( 4○, 7○) are trans- lated locally ( 5○, 6○) to achieve a coherent state across hosts.

templates.why_chosen: Star-rated symmetric-heterogeneous variant: private caches under two differently-colored protocol domains (pink Intel, purple Arm) read bottom-up through numbered request/response arrows into a shared dashed 'CXL Bridges' band and a shared Global Directory on top.
templates.what_to_learn: Give two heterogeneous host domains their own protocol color (pink, purple) that stays constant from their private caches up to the shared bridge, draw the bridge as one dashed band straddling both domains rather than a separate box, and number every request/response arrow even though this traversal runs bottom-up.

templates.why_chosen: Intel and Arm compute-node domains mirror the same Private Cache, Local Directory, Global CC/LLC stack, in red and purple, joined by a dashed CXL Bridges band to one shared, gold CXL Memory Expander Node above.
templates.what_to_learn: Give two heterogeneous host domains the identical internal box sequence (private caches, local directory, coherence block) so they read as one mirrored stack, then draw the shared directory they both bridge into as the one gold-accented box on the axis, and number the request and response arrows in one round trip out and back.
